body:
Noah P.: Hi team — got my Windows laptop but BitLocker won't enable. Intune shows the device as 'Pending Azure AD join' and the BitLocker toggle is grayed out. I tried signing in with my corp account during OOBE. Intro call in 40m, any quick tips?

IT Support: Welcome, Noah! That usually means TPM or Azure AD join didn't finish. Can you open an elevated PowerShell and run: `manage-bde -status` and `dsregcmd /status` and paste results? Also check Device Security -> Security processor (TPM) in Settings.

Noah P.: `manage-bde -status` shows OS drive: Protection Off. `dsregcmd /status` shows Device State: WorkplaceJoined: NO, AzureAdJoined: NO, but User is signed in. TPM settings say "No TPM found". Laptop is Lenovo ThinkPad X1.

IT Support: Looks like TPM is disabled at firmware level. Two paths: (1) quick: we can create a temporary local admin so you can finish the meeting from this machine and use the web app, or (2) longer: reflash BIOS settings to enable TPM + Secure Boot then re-run OOBE so Intune picks up the device and escrows the BitLocker key. Which do you prefer?

Marta (Onboarding): If you need to join the call now, request temp admin. We'll schedule a firmware change with Lenovo refresh later.

Noah P.: Need the meeting now. Please create temp admin.

IT Support: Creating a 24h temp admin now. Run this in an elevated cmd (paste as one line): `net user rwin_temp Passw0rd! /add && net localgroup administrators rwin_temp /add` then log out and sign in as rwin_temp. Don't change the password. We'll remove the account after 24h.

Noah P.: Done, I can log in as rwin_temp and join the call. Any notes about BitLocker after the firmware change?

IT Support: After we enable TPM in BIOS and confirm Azure AD join, BitLocker will be able to provision and the recovery key will be automatically backed up to Azure AD (you'll see it under your account devices in the portal). We'll book a 30-min window to update firmware — expect a reboot and BIOS prompt to accept TPM activation.

DevTools: Once BitLocker is on and device is Azure AD joined, we'll push developer packages and enroll you in our VPN certificate flow. Ping me when the device shows AzureAdJoined: YES.

Marta (Onboarding): Removing temp admin later today. Noah, welcome to Redwood Inference! If you run into any driver signing or WSL issues after updates, drop screenshots here.

Noah P.: Thanks all — great turnaround. I'll wait for the firmware slot and let you know. :thumbsup: 

onboarding-bot: Temp admin rwin_temp created and scheduled for deletion in 24h. Device pending firmware update for TPM activation. Welcome to Redwood Inference!"
